title: Exact Traces for Vector-Valued Morrey Spaces
summary: Trace spaces determine exactly which initial values are compatible with an evolution class. We identify the exact trace generated by vector-valued Morrey control in time and show that it differs essentially from the classical $L^p$ theory. For a Banach couple $X_1\hookrightarrow X_0$, the trace of the natural Morrey evolution class is the weak real-interpolation space $(X_0,X_1)_{θ,\infty}$, where $θ=1-(1-λ)/p$.
